baseline: p4 L100 PML+ABC at native CFL0.8
first_PP_definition: central |x-700|<=200m, +/-0.03s around .05+sqrt(700^2+(x-700)^2)/4087; diagnostic window, not pure mode decomposition
total_error: candidate at its dt minus expanded p4 control at baseline dt/2, includes time error and absorbing-boundary error; same spatial discretization, not exact PDE truth
boundary_error_same_dt: candidate minus expanded p4 control at exactly candidate dt; removes common time-discretization contribution
receivers: all top GLL strictly inside0<x<1400; additional outside20m mask; full0..1 and late0.5..1 windows. No receivers in PML
criterion: baseline is target, not truth; faster+no-worse requires both energy and peak errors <= baseline on full0..1 outside20m. All-receiver and late metrics also retained. No tolerances added to force success
native_CFL_note: new generic solver accepts CFL with PML but spectral estimate is ordinary elasticity/static damping; dt/2 controls retained
